name: 해방된 할파스
prompt:
Refine the attached first EAST12-pose animation source into a new version. Preserve the exact character identity and specific appearance of both references, while redrawing the locomotion anatomy as needed. All figures face screenRIGHT/EAST.  one transparent RGBA sprite sheet, PORTRAIT 2:3 aspect, high resolution. EXACTLY 2 columns and 6 rows of separate full-body characters = 12 poses, temporal order left to right then down. Every character is the SAME size/model, same view/camera/lighting, all facing true EAST / screen RIGHT. Use fixed camera and uniform scale; show the rightward profile/three-quarter side consistent with the attached original. Body, head, knees, feet all match this requested direction throughout. Clear wide gutters; at least 24 pixels transparent between all silhouettes. No overlap between adjacent cells, no clipping, all wings/horns/weapons/tail/feet completely visible. Give opposing leg/arm/cape responses and larger propulsion extension/compression at faster speed. Preserve rigid armor and the characteristic purple-wing geometry; avoid turning crystal/energy wings into feathered bird wings. All twelve articulated body poses must be distinct and temporally coherent. Keep luminosity INSIDE the physical silhouette; no huge external light circles. Leave generous empty gutters between each of12 independent full characters. No neighboring figure may enter another figure cell. Entire anatomy always visible and same scale. This is a clean SOURCE SPRITE SHEET, not an illustrated presentation plate. Exactly12 figures in a strict2-column6-row grid. First6 are walk/slow flight, last6 run/fast flight. Consistent model proportions and camera; use identical256px logical row heights and512px column widths on a1024x1536 source, ground/baseline240px inside each row. Leave more than32px empty space between full silhouettes.
